title: Rapture 99

== Introduction ==
Rapture 99 was a combined 4on4 and 1on1 tournament arranged in [[Scotland]] at the 26th of July back in the year [[1999]]. The 4on4 teams consisted of eight selected players from North America and Europe who clashed in an epic NA vs EU battle.
